summary: Frontend-only regression for v9 iteration. All 3 new UI features PASS: (1) Settings 'Send me a test digest now' button triggers 'Test digest sent to <email>' toast. (2) Settings Weekly summary toggle + weekday select persist across reload (enabled=true, day=4/Friday verified via GET /api/settings after reload). (3) Cluster legend note is rendered under the heatmap legend with expected text about average composite risk. (4) Reassign submission: reassign-select shows the other authorized reviewers (filtered to exclude current assignee), selecting one calls POST /submissions/{id}/reassign, updates the assignee-badge, shows 'Reassigned to <email>' toast, and appends a 'Reassigned to …' entry to the activity-trail (verified via backend GET after action). Regression: OTP login (verify-otp field name is 'otp' not 'code'), inbox loads, submission detail loads, claim/release flow works.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx: weekly_day/hour committed correctly via onChange={e => set(Number(e.target.value))}. Prior iteration_6 select flake did NOT reproduce in this run — select_option('4') persisted through Save+reload cleanly.
SubmissionDetail.jsx line 158: <select value="" onChange={reassign}> is a good pattern — resets to placeholder after each reassign; reviewers list correctly filtered by rec.assigned_to.

SubmissionDetail.jsx reassign() (line 109-117): optimistically updates rec.assigned_to and activity locally, matching backend response. Consider disabling the reassign-select while the POST is in flight to avoid double-dispatch, but not critical.

Dashboard.jsx cluster-legend-note (line 152) is a plain

— text is clear and mentions 'average composite risk' as required. Good.
Backend endpoint /api/auth/verify-otp expects field name 'otp' (not 'code' as some docs/prior tests used). Test-credentials note could be clearer, but not a bug.
